status: manifest only; shards not yet executed and no side-7 result claimed

partition.record_key: three little-endian u128 canonical streaming-state words followed by little-endian u16 local row bits
partition.equality: full record-key equality only; routing hashes never merge records
partition.ordering: ascending full record key within each destination shard

per_phase_algorithm: For every unique source record, emit both chosen=false and chosen=true exact successors.
Route each successor to its destination shard by the declared FNV-1a routing function.
Externally sort each destination by its full record key and remove only byte-identical records.
Record both destination record IDs for every source transition; repeat through position 49.
At position 49 assign the exact three-bit terminal threshold output.
Process transition files backward; two source records share a class exactly when their false and true successor class IDs are equal.
Use the resulting phase automaton in the global product and OR terminal flags over all connected U=72 states.
aggregate_criterion: Side 7 has no violation iff the completed global product using the assembled automaton has connected=true and the bitwise OR of all terminal threshold outputs is zero. Every shard and both outgoing transitions of every source record are required.
